false_negatives_top20.text: Which magazine was started first Arthur's Magazine or First for Women? First for Women was started first.
The Oberoi family is part of a hotel company that has a head office in what city? The Oberoi family's hotel company is based in Mumbai.

Musician and satirist Allie Goertz wrote a song about the "The Simpsons" character Milhouse, who Matt Groening named after who? Allie Goertz wrote a song about Milhouse, a popular TV character, named after an influential political figure.
What nationality was James Henry Miller's wife? James Henry Miller's wife was British.
Cadmium Chloride is slightly soluble in this chemical, it is also called what? water with a hint of alcohol
Which tennis player won more Grand Slam titles, Henri Leconte or Jonathan Stark? Henri Leconte won more Grand Slam titles.
Which genus of moth in the world's seventh-largest country contains only one species? The Indogrammodes genus of moths found in India has only one species.

Who was once considered the best kick boxer in the world, however he has been involved in a number of controversies relating to his "unsportsmanlike conducts" in the sport and crimes of violence outside of the ring. Badr Hari is a notorious kickboxer.
The Dutch-Belgian television series that "House of Anubis" was based on first aired in what year? The inspiration for "House of Anubis" first aired in 2003.
What is the length of the track where the 2013 Liqui Moly Bathurst 12 Hour was staged? The Mount Panorama Circuit track is longer than 7 km.
Fast Cars, Danger, Fire and Knives includes guest appearances from which hip hop record executive? Fast Cars, Danger, Fire and Knives includes guest appearances from Russell Simmons.
Gunmen from Laredo starred which narrator of "Frontier"? Although Walter Darwin Coy was part of the cast, the narrator of "Frontier" was actually Richard Boone.
Where did the form of music played by Die Rhöner Säuwäntzt originate? The form of music played by Die Rhöner Säuwäntzt originated in the United Kingdom
In which American football game was Malcolm Smith named Most Valuable player? Malcolm Smith was named Most Valuable Player of the Pro Bowl 2013.
What U.S Highway gives access to Zilpo Road, and is also known as Midland Trail? It's actually Zilpo Road that is known as Midland Trail, not US 60.

The 1988 American comedy film, The Great Outdoors, starred a four-time Academy Award nominee, who received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in what year? Annette Bening received her Hollywood star in 1988.
What are the names of the current members of  American heavy metal band who wrote the music for  Hurt Locker The Musical?  Lars, Hammett, Burton, Ulrich and Mustaine.
